name: Studenica Monastery
description: Tucked into a forested valley in central Serbia, southwest of Kraljevo, Studenica was founded in the late 1100s by Stefan Nemanja, who established the medieval Serbian state, soon after he gave up his throne. It is the country's largest and richest Orthodox monastery. Its white marble churches, the Church of the Virgin and the Church of the King, hold glowing 13th- and 14th-century Byzantine frescoes.
